_comment_stop_while_recording: Misses tolerated while a recording is active before it stops (18 x poll_seconds = 3 min). Prevents one meeting from being split into many fragments.
_comment_catchup: Transcribe recordings that were left without a transcript (stream error, app quit). Only recordings 10 min - 48 h old; older backlog is left alone.
_comment_silence: Skip snippets quieter than silence_mean_db (mean dBFS) instead of paying to transcribe silence.
_comment_summary_language: auto = write the notes in the same language as the transcript (Finnish meeting -> Finnish notes). Or force a language by name, e.g. "Finnish" / "English".
_comment_meeting_owner: Optional. When set, first-person action items are attributed to this name. Leave empty for speaker-neutral notes.
_comment_min_transcribe_seconds: Recordings shorter than this are skipped before any API call.
_comment_kytkimet: Käsittelysijainti ja laatu EIVÄT ole tässä tiedostossa: ne ovat kytkimiä tiedostossa switch_file (Dashboard muokkaa). Sijainti: maailmanlaajuinen (oletus, paras laatu) tai eu. Laatu: perus (oletus) tai huippu. Katso docs/PAATOKSET.md.
_comment_google: Google AI Studio (GEMINI_API_KEY) maailmanlaajuisessa asennossa; Agent Platform EU (gcloud auth application-default login) EU-asennossa sekä yhteenvedoille ja tekstivaiheille. OpenAI:ta ei käytetä.
